contract: Each required Shield test binds one minimal contract-deviation counterexample (mutation) and a kill verification, verified via the §12.5 protocol. All 5 patches apply cleanly against the current HEAD (verified via git apply --check). The 4 targeted patches (hotfix_anchor_no_redispatch, hotfix_anchor_auto_feature_backlog, hotfix_fix_commit_leaks_to_main, hotfix_baseline_fresh_never_stale) were regenerated from the current tracks/cli/main.py layout after the _COMMANDS drifted to line 1311 (PRISM-V06-R14-01). Each regenerated patch has been re-verified: git apply --check passes, syntax AST-valid, and kills its bound test. The legal-Red source for the CLI-driven hotfix tests was redefined per PRISM-V06-R14-02 path (1): the hotfix delta run's inherited-baseline resolver (IF-HOTFIX-010 resolve_inherited_baseline_docs) is not wired into the run-loop validate step, so the run parks at stage=M-DESIGN awaiting=escalation reason=[trace] test-plan validate requires acceptance.md in same dir — a legitimate unimplemented-state signal under a compliant runtime. Entry-phase tests that asserted only implemented entry outlets were re-anchored per R14-02 path (a): they now append a drive-to-M-TEST assertion that fails at the IF-HOTFIX-010 seam, converting illegal-green to legal-red. The fresh-unpatched failure point for each bound test is described in its per-binding verification. Most fail at the IF-HOTFIX-010 seam (stage=M-DESIGN awaiting=escalation reason=[trace] test-plan validate requires acceptance.md in same dir); tests whose AC terminates at entry (REJECTED, FEATURE_ROUTE, lock-reject) produce a fresh-entry seam drive on issue 58. The 4 tests whose earlier failure points were PRECHECK rejection / validate frontmatter / hotfix_scope absence (R15-01) have been fixed by correcting the fixtures (approving v0.6 baseline, adding M-DESIGN run, completing delta plan frontmatter) so they now fail at the IF-HOTFIX-010 seam. trace_binds continues to fail at hotfix_scope absence (the IF-HOTFIX-010 resolve not wired into check trace).
